P1_cutoff_homogeneity_and_surface.conclusion: Every episode in all three splits gives its 8 machines one identical cutoff, so the released files contain ZERO neighbour ticks at or after a target cutoff. The neighbour-future leak condition never arises naturally on this data, and the organizer's index_history() would reject a file where it did. The mutation tests therefore probe a counterfactual: they prove the code stays causal under a broader event stream, not that a live risk was caught.

P2_changepoint_positional_slice.conclusion: The slice only chooses WHICH ticks are candidate changepoints. The statistic uses tick arithmetic range(t-20,t) / range(t,t+20) guarded by `if s in h` and >=15 present observations per side. For short_history only 1329 of 4800 candidates survive, and all 1329 sit inside the dense recent-40 region, so sparse older rows are never averaged as 20 adjacent observations.

P3_label_reachability.conclusion: Inside slot_model/ the only module that touches conditions.csv, targets.csv or reference.csv is official_score.py, a scoring module. No feature builder (features.py, phase2_features.py, phase2_tables.py, mtd.py, mtd_pairs.py, shared_state.py) can reach a condition or target label. In the component scripts they are read only after write_submission, feeding contest_score.
